description: Function-level budget registry (two-level exception model): every 80-120 line function is registered with a real classification, reason, class owner and future reviewBy; unregistered, unclassified, expired and stale entries fail. Functions over 120 lines always fail. Path-level file-budget exceptions live in config/exceptions.json.
